info.title: revv-api

get.summary: Public resale report snapshot — no auth, the token is the key
Redirect to a freshly-signed download URL for the report PDF

patch.summary: Edit a reminder, or mark it completed (markCompleted: true)

post.summary: Revoke this report and generate a fresh one for the same vehicle
Revoke a report — its link and PDF 404 immediately
Attach a receipt or photo to a service record (multipart/form-data, field "file")

get.summary: List service types (the open enum, for pickers) — unpaginated

post.summary: Add a vehicle (client supplies the id; a re-POST of an existing id returns it)
Decode this vehicle’s VIN via NHTSA and cache it — always 200; degrades to decoded:false if NHTSA is unavailable

get.summary: A vehicle's reminders, with computed status

post.summary: Create a reminder (client supplies the id; a re-POST of an existing id returns it)

get.summary: A vehicle's reports (no share tokens — those are shown once, at generation)

post.summary: Generate a resale report — returns the share token once

get.summary: A vehicle's service history, newest first

post.summary: Log a service (client supplies the id; a re-POST of an existing id returns it)
